mainEntity.name: I just got my countertops installed—when should backsplash tile go in?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backsplash is usually installed after the countertops are in and the wall is prepped. For most kitchens in Denver-area homes, the first step is a site measure so the installer can check wall flatness, outlet locations, and how much tile is needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install the backsplash after the countertops, once the wall is measured and prepped. That lets the installer account for outlets, uneven spots, and exact tile cuts.
